prompt: You want to break the habit of scrolling in bed late at night. Which environment change is most likely to work?

options.text: Rely on willpower to put the phone down at a set time each night
Charge the phone in the kitchen overnight and use a simple alarm clock instead
Delete one social app but keep the rest on the phone in your bedroom
Turn the screen brightness down so scrolling feels less appealing

explanation: Moving the phone out of reach removes the cue and adds friction, which changes the habit far more reliably than promising yourself you will resist it in the moment.
